# AI in Education – Automated Daily Briefing Dashboard

This workflow automatically collects the latest AI-in-Education news, processes and normalizes article data, summarizes trends and top stories using LLMs, and publishes a polished, interactive dashboard through a webhook.

## Pipeline Overview
1. Data Collection: Fetches AI-related news from multiple Google News RSS feeds.
2. Pre-Processing: Cleans, filters, and restructures article metadata.
3. Aggregation: Merges all article streams into a unified dataset.
4. LLM Preparation: Formats and structures content for multi-article analysis.
5. AI Summarization: Uses GPT to generate top stories, trends, insights, keywords, and a source overview.
6. Dashboard Generation: Converts the LLM output to a stylized HTML report.
7. Publishing: Returns the dashboard through a public webhook for live viewing.

## Purpose 
Creates a centralized, auto-updated daily news intelligence tool for educators, policymakers, and researchers who need rapid insights into AI trends in education.

## Data Collection

Two Google News RSS feeds (AI Education + EdTech AI) are pulled to gather the most recent stories about artificial intelligence in educational contexts.

### Purpose:
> Ensures wide news coverage
> Captures stories from diverse publishers
> Provides titles, summaries, and metadata for each article


This step acts as the “raw information intake” of the entire system — without high-quality data sources, insights later in the pipeline would be weak or biased.

## Content Cleaning & Normalization

Each feed goes through JavaScript cleaning + field selection to:

> Remove duplicates
> Standardize titles, summaries, timestamps
> Extract publisher domains
> Filter out irrelevant or malformed articles

### Purpose:
Normalize the structure so multiple news feeds can be merged and processed identically.

## Dataset Aggregation & Preparation for LLM

Both cleaned datasets are merged

All articles are transformed into a structured multi-article text block
(“Article 1: Title… Summary… Link… Source…”)

Output becomes articlesText ready for summarization

### Purpose:
To give the LLM a complete, unified “news corpus” from which to extract trends.

## AI Summarization & Trend Analysis (LLM)

GPT-4o-mini receives the combined news text and returns a structured briefing:

> Top Stories (5–7)
> Trends & Patterns
> Risks & Challenges
> Opportunities
> Trending Keywords
> Source Breakdown

### Purpose:
Transform raw news into meaningful, contextualized insights.

You are an expert AI analyst specializing in education technology.
Your job is to read incoming AI-in-education news articles and produce a concise, professional daily briefing.

=You will receive a combined dataset of 36+ AI-in-education news articles.

Using these articles, write a structured DAILY BRIEFING following this exact shape:

Daily Briefing: AI in Education

1. Top Stories (5–7 items)
- Write short headline-like summaries for the most important stories.
- Each should have a bolded title and a one-sentence summary.

2. Trends, Insights & Patterns
- Identify recurring themes across articles.
- Keep bullets short but insightful.

3. Risks, Challenges & Concerns
- Summarize issues raised by multiple articles.
- Keep them actionable.

4. Opportunities & Promising Practices
- Highlight innovations, good uses of AI in education, pilots, or collaborations.

After the 4 sections end, output two special blocks:

[SOURCES]
List “Domain | Count” for each unique news website domain you see in the dataset.
Example:
nytimes.com | 3
edweek.org | 2

[KEYWORDS]
Extract 8–12 trending keywords across all articles (comma-separated, no #).

## Dashboard Generation & Delivery

> LLM output is parsed
> A fully styled HTML dashboard is generated
> Keyword chips, colored cards, source tables, timestamps, and formatting are applied
> Webhook returns the HTML dashboard as a live web page

### Purpose:
Produce a user-facing “AI in Education Daily Briefing” website.
